semiconductor_relevance: Low — SANYO DENKI KOREA primarily provides motors and cooling solutions rather than semiconductor-specific products.
summary: SANYO DENKI KOREA Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of SANYO DENKI, Japan, established to supply high-performance and reliable products to the Korean market. Their focus includes servo motors, amplifiers, and cooling fans, which are essential for various industrial applications but do not directly pertain to semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Cooling fans including low power consumption and splash proof fans

regional_presence.Korea: SANYO DENKI KOREA operates as a subsidiary focused on the Korean market.
